knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The arrest category accepts a fall and halts it. Restraint prevents the worker reaching the edge.
The clearance is the full distance a worker falls before stopping, plus margin. The lanyard length is only one part of it.
The sources require an anchor rated for the purpose, checked by a competent individual and placed where it limits the fall. Light pipe, conduit and timber rails are named as unsuitable.

practicalCriteria: Names the four categories and assigns each to a supplied scenario
Calculates a fall clearance from supplied figures with each factor shown
Identifies an anchor the assessor marks as unsuitable, and rejects it with a reason
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A clearance calculated from lanyard length alone means the sheet is returned
Any anchor that is not rated for the purpose is not used
